entries.title: Exodus 39:1
segments: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary. And they made the holy garments for Aaron, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 39:2
segments: And he made the ephod [of] gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached [linen].

entries.title: Exodus 39:3
segments: And they beat the gold into thin plates, and cut threads to work [it] into the blue, and into the purple, and into the scarlet, and into the bleached [linen], the work of an artisan.

entries.title: Exodus 39:4
segments: They made shoulder-pieces for it, to couple [it] together. It was coupled together by the two edges.

entries.title: Exodus 39:5
segments: And its fastening band which [was] on it, was of it, according to its work; gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached [linen], even as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 39:6
segments: And they made stones of onyx set [in] plaited work of gold, engraved as signets are engraved, with the names of the sons of Israel.

entries.title: Exodus 39:7
segments: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, stones for a memorial to the sons of Israel, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 39:8
segments: And he made the breast-pocket a work [of] an artisan, like the work of the ephod, of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached [linen];

entries.title: Exodus 39:9
segments: it was square. They made the breast-pocket double. Its length [was] a span, and its breadth a span, doubled.

entries.title: Exodus 39:10
segments: And they set four rows of stones in it. One row was a ruby, a topaz, and a carbuncle, the first row.

entries.title: Exodus 39:11
segments: And the second row: an turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond.

entries.title: Exodus 39:12
segments: And the third row: a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst.

entries.title: Exodus 39:13
segments: And the fourth row: a chrysolite, an agate, and a jasper; set in plaited work of gold in their settings.

entries.title: Exodus 39:14
segments: And the stones were according to the names of the sons of Israel, twelve, according to their names, [like] the engravings of a signet, every one with its name according to the twelve tribes.

entries.title: Exodus 39:15
segments: And they made cords of chains upon the breast-pocket, of woven work [of] pure gold.

entries.title: Exodus 39:16
segments: And they made two plaitings [of] gold and two gold rings. And they put the two rings on the two ends of the breast-pocket.

entries.title: Exodus 39:17
segments: And they put the two cords of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breast-pocket.

entries.title: Exodus 39:18
segments: And the two ends of the two cords were fastened in the two plaitings. And they put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, on its front.

entries.title: Exodus 39:19
segments: And they made two rings of gold. And they put [them] on the two ends of the breast-pocket, on its border, on the side of the ephod inward.

entries.title: Exodus 39:20
segments: And they made two golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the front of it, near the other coupling of it, above to the band of the ephod.

entries.title: Exodus 39:21
segments: And they bound the breast-pocket by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, so that it might be above the band of the ephod, and so that the breast-pocket might not be loosened from the ephod, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 39:22
segments: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

entries.title: Exodus 39:23
segments: And the opening in the middle of the robe [was] like the opening of a corselet, with a band around the opening, so that it might not tear.

entries.title: Exodus 39:24
segments: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined bleached [linen].

entries.title: Exodus 39:25
segments: And they made bells [of] pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hems of the robe, all around, between the pomegranates:

entries.title: Exodus 39:26
segments: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, all around the hem of the robe to minister [in], even as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 39:27
segments: And they made the tunics [of] bleached [linen] [of] woven work for Aaron and for his sons.

entries.title: Exodus 39:28
segments: And [they made] a miter of bleached [linen], and the headdress of the caps [of] bleached [linen], and linen breeches [of] fine twined bleached [linen],

entries.title: Exodus 39:29
segments: and a girdle [of] fine twined bleached [linen], and blue, and purple, and scarlet, [of] needlework, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 39:30
segments: And they made the plate of the holy crown [of] pure gold, and wrote upon it an inscription of the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

entries.title: Exodus 39:31
segments: And they tied a lace of blue to it, in order to fasten [it] on high upon the miter, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 39:32
segments: And all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation was finished. And the sons of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses. So they did.

entries.title: Exodus 39:33
segments: And they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent, and all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets,

entries.title: Exodus 39:34
segments: and the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of dugong skins, and the veil of the covering,

entries.title: Exodus 39:35
segments: the ark of the testimony, and its staves, and the mercy-seat,

entries.title: Exodus 39:36
segments: the table, [and] all its vessels, and the showbread,

entries.title: Exodus 39:37
segments: the pure lampstand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels of it, and the oil for light,

entries.title: Exodus 39:38
segments: and the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the screen for the tabernacle door,

entries.title: Exodus 39:39
segments: the bronze altar, and its grate of bronze, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base,

entries.title: Exodus 39:40
segments: the curtains of the court, its pillars and its sockets, and the screen for the court gate, its cords, and its pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle for the tent of the congregation,

entries.title: Exodus 39:41
segments: the woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister in the priest's office.

entries.title: Exodus 39:42
segments: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel made all the work.

entries.title: Exodus 39:43
segments: And Moses looked upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it. As the LORD commanded, even so they had done it. And Moses blessed them.
